meta.title: MEAT — Mortality Engineered Auto-Trading
meta.description: Mortality-engineered multi-agent trading on Alpaca: six roles with stoplines, a death rule, replication with mutation and an external Reaper. In the Harness sidebar: a live population dashboard with research cadence controls, daily/weekly/monthly leaderboards, configurable winner rewards, and per-agent strategy plans, transactions and research briefings.
